title: Rejection Probability as Failed-Check Frequency
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, Boolean input word $w$ of length $m+2$, and Boolean proof word $q$ of length $m+1$, the rejection probability of the odd-weight partial-sum verifier equals the uniform probability, over seeds in $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\sqcup\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, that the corresponding partial-sum check fails.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $m+2$
$q$ is a Boolean proof word of length $m+1$
